responsibility: This module is the imported DMD front-end subtree used by GDC to implement the D language’s source-language processing before GCC middle-end lowering. It covers the full D front-end pipeline: lexical analysis and parsing (`lexer`, `tokens`, `parse`), the core AST and symbol/type system (`expression`, `statement`, `dsymbol`, `declaration`, `mtype`, `template`, `module`, aggregate/class/struct/enum support), and the multi-pass semantic analysis that resolves names, attributes, imports, access control, templates, overloads, initializers, statements, and function/aggregate bodies (`dsymbolsem`, `expressionsem`, `statementsem`, `typesem`, `semantic2`, `semantic3`). It also includes D-specific compile-time execution and optimization facilities such as constant folding, CTFE interpretation, integer-range reasoning, escape/safety/nogc/nothrow checking, array-operation synthesis, operator overloading, mangling for D and C++, inline-asm handling, TypeInfo/runtime metadata preparation, and special outputs like Ddoc, header regeneration, and JSON introspection. Supporting `root/` and `common/` subtrees provide the portability, memory, file/path, container, string, Unicode, and output-buffer utilities that the imported front end depends on. As a localization unit, this module is the D language front end itself: it is responsible for understanding D syntax and semantics and producing the semantically elaborated D program representation consumed by the rest of GDC/GCC.
